images.tooltip: The shot to learn from (IMAGE batch, sRGB).

target_alpha.tooltip: Correct mattes, white = subject: one per frame, or one per frame listed in target_frames. Rotoscoped or cleaned-up keys work well.

target_frames.tooltip: Frame number of each target matte, e.g. '0, 24, 48'. Empty: the mattes belong to the first frames of the clip, in order.

scope.tooltip: Layers that get adapters. stage2: final refinement only (edges, color). decoder+stage2: also the stage-1 decoder. all: every stage-1 and stage-2 block, including subject selection; the foundation models are never trained.

lora_alpha.tooltip: LoRA alpha; the change is scaled by lora_alpha / rank.

learning_rate.tooltip: Peak AdamW learning rate (short warmup, then cosine decay to 10%).

window_frames.tooltip: Consecutive frames per training step (temporal context). More frames use more VRAM.

crop.tooltip: Square training crop at native resolution, a multiple of 128. 0 = largest that fits in free VRAM. On Windows, a crop that would exceed the commit limit (RAM plus page file) stops with an error before training.

augment.tooltip: Random horizontal flips and mild color jitter, the same across a window.

seed.tooltip: Seed for crops, hints, augmentation and adapter initialization.

save_name.tooltip: File name in the CorridorKey 2.0 LoRA folder (models/corridorkey2/loras, unless extra_model_paths.yaml sets corridorkey2_loras; empty = do not save). An existing file is never overwritten. Set it before running: ComfyUI runs a node again when any of its inputs changes, so changing only save_name afterwards repeats the whole fine-tune.

loss_alpha.tooltip: Weight of the alpha loss. Charbonnier L1 on the raw matte.

loss_split.tooltip: Weight of the split loss. L1 averaged separately over the edge/transparency band and the solid regions, so thin edges count as much as large areas.

loss_laplacian.tooltip: Weight of the laplacian loss. Laplacian-pyramid L1: matte structure at several scales.

loss_gradient.tooltip: Weight of the gradient loss. Sobel gradient L1: edge sharpness.

loss_composition.tooltip: Weight of the composition loss. Re-composite over the background plate vs the input frame (only with a background input).

loss_fg.tooltip: Weight of the fg loss. Foreground color L1 where the target matte is > 0 (only with a target_fg input).

loss_temporal.tooltip: Weight of the temporal loss. Frame-to-frame change of the matte (and foreground) must match the target's: reduces flicker. Uses consecutive target frames only.

loss_aux.tooltip: Weight of the aux loss. Deep supervision of the half-resolution stage-1 matte (scopes with stage-1 layers).

loss_bottleneck.tooltip: Weight of the bottleneck loss. Supervision of the stage-1 /8 decision head (scope 'all' only).

hint_none.tooltip: Share of steps trained without a hint. Shares are normalized.

hint_first_frame.tooltip: Share of steps with a first-frame hint (quality 0.75-0.95). Shares are normalized.

hint_carry.tooltip: Share of steps where the first half of the window gets a carried hint, as between overlapping temporal windows (quality 0.95). Shares are normalized.

hint_degraded.tooltip: Share of steps with a rough hint on every frame (quality 0.5-0.75). Shares are normalized.

target_fg.tooltip: Correct straight sRGB foreground for the target frames (same count as target_alpha).

background.tooltip: Clean plate of the screen without the subject (1 frame or one per frame).

init_lora.tooltip: Continue training this LoRA (its scope, rank and alpha are used). Do not also apply it to the model.

output_tooltips: The trained LoRA. Apply it with the CorridorKey 2.0 LoRA node.
Loss per step, for Plot Loss Graph.
CorridorKey2FineTuneAdvanced.name: CorridorKey2FineTuneAdvanced
CorridorKey2FineTuneAdvanced.description: LoRA fine-tuning with every knob: adapted layers, rank, learning rate, temporal window, crop size, per-term loss weights (alpha, split, Laplacian, gradient, composition, foreground, temporal, deep supervision) and the hint curriculum. A target foreground enables the foreground loss and a clean background plate the composition loss.
